text:
Jordan_AE: FYI — kickoff thread for Acme Health POC. They need HIPAA-safe handling, a 2-week evaluation for an in-app summarization feature, and a DPA before we start sending logs. Can we scope?
Devon_SE: Thanks. Quick clarifications: is customer ok with Redwood Dedicated (reserved) or do they require private on‑prem?
Jordan_AE: They prefer Hosted initially but only if PHI never leaves their VPC. Legal flagged DPA + SOC2 Type II report; infra team suggested Dedicated with VPC peering as fallback. Budget: $12k for the POC.
Maria_Security: Tagging security questions: we need the flow of PHI for the POC. If any PHI is ingested we require either Private deployment or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS. Also need to provide SOC2 report, current pen-test summary, and DPA draft.
Chris_Eng: From an engineering viewpoint: for a 2-week POC we can spin up a Dedicated pool with private routing. We'll need the sample prompt set and expected QPS. Do we have target latency/quality metrics?
Jordan_AE: Customer use case: in-app clinical note summarization and redact PHI. Success criteria they listed: 1) summary accuracy vs human baseline (F1 > 0.85 on entity preservation), 2) P95 latency < 300ms for 512-token responses, 3) no PHI leaks in 1000 eval prompts. Timeline: Week 0: onboarding + DPA; Week 1: model runs + evals; Week 2: adjustments + final report.
Devon_SE: Draft eval harness idea: run 1k prompts, measure ROUGE-L and entity F1, and run a privacy regression where we inject synthetic PHI and ensure no direct verbatim reproduction. Example eval command we plan to run: ```bash
# run eval
python eval.py --model redwood-1-quant --prompts prompts.json --metrics rouge,entity_f1,leak_rate
```
Maria_Security: Required artifacts from our side to the customer: SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months), DPA template, description of data-in-transit+at-rest encryption, KMS integration doc, and pen-test executive summary. For HIPAA: BAAs are required for production; for POC they asked but legal says we can do a scoped DPA + controls attestation. Liz_Legal can confirm.
Liz_Legal: Confirmed. We'll send the standard DPA + a one-off POC addendum stating limited dataset, retention 30 days max, and no secondary use. For SOC2 we can provide the report PDF and an auditor letter. Pen-test: we have a summary and can coordinate a deeper scan if customer demands — that'll add ~2 weeks and cost.
Jordan_AE: Pricing ask: can we apply a POC credit to Dedicated usage? Customer expects ~$12k cap.
Devon_SE: We can offer a reduced rate for the POC (50% off hosted per-token) if they use Dedicated and commit to the 2-week reserved pool. Ops will need an emergency scale plan for burst.
Chris_Eng: Technical blocker: if they want redaction guarantee we should propose a pipeline: client-side pre-redaction ruleset -> model -> server-side post-checks (regex + model-based detection). That reduces leak_rate to near zero in practice. We'll include a simple post-check in the POC.
Maria_Security: Pen-test ask: customer requires scope to include external network tests and application-level review of the inference endpoint. We can provide our external pen-test summary; for in-depth customer pen-test we need an NDA and a window. Also confirm we will not store raw prompts beyond the 30-day retention.
Liz_Legal: I'll attach the DPA draft and POC addendum in this thread (will email too). Also ask Acme to sign the NDA before pen-test scheduling.
deploy-bot: New Dedicated cluster request created: cluster-acme-poc-171802 — ETA 2 business days.
Jordan_AE: Next steps I propose: 1) Liz send DPA + addendum to customer today, 2) Maria share SOC2 + pen-test summary links, 3) Devon prepare eval harness and sample prompts, 4) Chris stand by for cluster config. Target kickoff next Wednesday. Everyone ok? :thumbsup:
Devon_SE: Ok from SE side — I'll upload prompts.json and eval script link once cluster ready.
Maria_Security: I'll share artifacts to the secure link (S3 pre-signed) and DM the access controls.
Chris_Eng: Will prepare the post-check hooks and a rollout plan for canary traffic.
Liz_Legal: DPA sent to Acme legal; asked for signature within 48 hours.
Jordan_AE: Great — I'll update the customer and set a calendar invite for kickoff. Thanks all. :rocket:
